answer: A bond is refunded only after 44 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The yarrow counter is kept in umber and island shows each reset. Someone therefore has to keep every alias continuously active for 44 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 3702 identities would post 3973 proofs and burn roughly 85 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
